title: Growth Strategy & Consulting
heading: Build a Clearer Direction for Your Digital Growth
intro: Marketing activities are more effective when they begin with a clear understanding of the business, market, customer, offer and available resources. Indieur helps businesses assess their current position, identify growth gaps and prioritise the activities that deserve attention now.
challenge: Businesses often invest in advertising, content or technology without first identifying the real problem.
The issue may be weak positioning, the wrong audience, an unclear offer, poor conversion tracking, delayed lead follow-up or insufficient customer retention.
Without diagnosis, increasing marketing activity can increase costs without solving the underlying gap.
approach: We begin by understanding your business model, customers, offer, competition, current marketing and operational capacity.
We then separate immediate priorities from activities that should be tested later and develop a focused, realistic growth direction.

faqs.question: Is this only for new businesses?
faqs.answer: No. It can support new businesses, established businesses entering a new growth stage and companies whose current marketing is not producing sufficient clarity.

faqs.question: Will we receive a complete implementation plan?
faqs.answer: The deliverables depend on the agreed scope. We will clearly define whether the engagement covers diagnosis, planning, implementation support or an ongoing growth programme.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee business results?
faqs.answer: No. Results depend on the market, offer, competition, budget, execution, tracking and operational capacity. We provide structured analysis, execution and optimisation without unsupported guarantees.

title: Meta Ads Management
heading: Structured Facebook and Instagram Advertising for Business Growth
intro: Indieur plans and manages Meta advertising campaigns based on your business objective, audience, offer, customer journey and available budget. Campaigns may focus on awareness, enquiries, WhatsApp conversations, website actions, ecommerce purchases or customer re-engagement.
features: Meta Ads account and campaign review
challenge: Meta Ads can generate reach and traffic, but performance may suffer when the offer, creative, audience, landing experience, tracking or follow-up system is weak.
A successful campaign requires more than selecting an audience and publishing an advertisement.
approach: We connect campaign objectives with meaningful business actions.

Campaign performance is reviewed using relevant indicators such as qualified leads, WhatsApp conversations, purchases, conversion rates, acquisition costs and revenue where reliable tracking is available.

faqs.question: Is advertising spend included?
faqs.answer: No. Meta advertising spend is paid separately by the client.

faqs.question: Are creatives included?
faqs.answer: Ad copy and creative direction may be included depending on the scope. Design, photography, video production and other production requirements will be confirmed separately.

faqs.question: How quickly will we see results?
faqs.answer: Performance depends on the offer, market, budget, creative quality, tracking and conversion journey. The campaign requires adequate time and data before reliable optimisation decisions can be made.

ctaTitle: Ready to Improve Your Meta Advertising?

title: Google Ads Management
heading: Reach Customers Who Are Actively Searching
intro: Google Ads helps businesses reach people already searching for relevant products, services or solutions. Indieur plans and manages campaigns around customer intent, keyword relevance, location, competition, landing-page experience and measurable conversions.
challenge: Clicks alone do not indicate campaign success.
Businesses may lose budget through irrelevant searches, weak landing pages, broad targeting, incomplete conversion tracking or poor lead handling.
approach: We focus on connecting relevant search demand with the right advertisement, landing experience and conversion action.
Search terms, costs, user behaviour and meaningful conversions are reviewed regularly to guide optimisation.

faqs.question: Is Google Ads spend included?
faqs.answer: No. Advertising spend is paid directly by the client and is separate from Indieur’s professional fee.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee a fixed number of leads?
faqs.answer: No. Lead volume and quality depend on search demand, competition, budget, landing experience, offer and sales response.

faqs.question: Do we need conversion tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reliable conversion tracking is important for measuring and optimising meaningful actions rather than clicks alone.

title: Search Engine Optimisation
heading: Improve Your Website’s Search Visibility and Technical Foundation
intro: Indieur helps businesses improve how their websites are understood, crawled and discovered through search engines. The SEO scope is based on the website’s technical condition, competition, content, catalogue size, locations and growth priorities.
challenge: A website may look attractive but still struggle to rank because of technical errors, poor content structure, weak relevance, duplicate pages, indexation problems or insufficient authority.
SEO requires coordinated improvements rather than inserting keywords into existing pages.
approach: We begin with the technical and search foundation, map relevant search intent and prioritise the pages with the strongest business value.
Progress is monitored through search visibility, indexation, rankings, qualified organic traffic and meaningful website actions.
serviceFeatures: Local or ecommerce SEO where relevant

faqs.question: How long does SEO take?
faqs.answer: SEO is a long-term process. The timeline depends on competition, website condition, content, authority and implementation speed.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
faqs.answer: No. Search rankings are influenced by several factors and cannot responsibly be guaranteed.

faqs.question: Is content writing included?
faqs.answer: Content planning may be included. The number of pages, articles or product descriptions will be defined in the final scope.

title: Social Media & Content Marketing
breadcrumb: Home / Services / Social Media & Content Marketing
heading: Build a More Consistent and Purposeful Content Presence
intro: Indieur helps businesses use social media and content to improve visibility, communication, customer trust and campaign support. Content is planned around the audience, platform, business objective and available production capacity.
challenge: Posting frequently does not automatically produce business growth.
Content may fail when it lacks audience relevance, platform suitability, message consistency, strong calls to action or connection with the wider customer journey.
approach: We build content around clear purposes such as discovery, education, trust, engagement, lead generation, sales support and retention.
Performance is reviewed to understand which formats, messages and topics deserve continued investment.

faqs.question: Are design and video production included?
faqs.answer: The final scope will specify the number of designs, reels, videos and revisions. Photography, advanced video production and creator costs may be quoted separately.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you manage?
faqs.answer: Platforms are selected according to the target audience and business objective rather than automatically including every social network.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee follower growth?
faqs.answer: No. We focus on relevant audience growth, useful engagement and business-aligned content rather than guaranteeing vanity metrics.

ctaTitle: Build a Stronger Social Media Direction

title: WhatsApp Marketing & Automation
heading: Turn WhatsApp Into a Structured Customer Communication Channel
intro: Indieur helps businesses use WhatsApp for enquiries, campaigns, automated responses, customer follow-ups, reactivation and retention. The final solution is designed according to the business journey, approved use cases, available customer data and selected WhatsApp platform provider.
challenge: Businesses often receive enquiries through WhatsApp but lack structured responses, lead routing, follow-ups, segmentation or campaign measurement.
This can result in missed enquiries and inconsistent customer communication.
approach: We map the required customer journey before configuring campaigns or automation.
The scope identifies which actions need automation, which require human assistance and how customer data and consent must be handled.
importantServiceNote: WhatsApp platform subscriptions, Meta message charges, advertising spend, custom integrations and third-party tools are paid separately by the client. Business verification and message-template approval remain subject to Meta’s review and cannot be guaranteed.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee WhatsApp verification?
faqs.answer: No. We can provide documentation and readiness assistance, but approval is controlled by Meta.

faqs.question: Can you send messages to any customer list?
faqs.answer: Customer data must be lawfully collected, accurate and supported by appropriate consent. The client remains responsible for data ownership and compliance.

faqs.question: Are new automations included in ongoing campaign management?
faqs.answer: Only the agreed campaign-management activities are included. New bots, automation journeys and custom integrations require separate assessment and quotation.

ctaTitle: Build a Better WhatsApp Customer Journey

title: Email, SMS & Retention Marketing
breadcrumb: Home / Services / Email, SMS & Retention Marketing
heading: Build Stronger Relationships Beyond the First Purchase
intro: Indieur helps businesses communicate with existing customers through relevant, segmented and timely retention campaigns. The objective is to improve customer engagement, reactivation, repeat purchases and long-term value.
challenge: Many businesses invest heavily in acquiring new customers but have no structured communication after the first enquiry or purchase.
This creates dependence on continuous advertising while existing customer opportunities remain underused.
approach: We organise customers according to meaningful lifecycle stages and create communication journeys relevant to their behaviour and relationship with the business.

faqs.question: Do you provide the email or SMS platform?
faqs.answer: We can recommend and support suitable tools. Platform subscriptions and message charges are paid separately by the client.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing customer database?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to data quality, lawful collection, consent and platform compatibility.

faqs.question: Is customer retention guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Retention depends on product quality, customer experience, pricing, fulfilment and communication in addition to marketing.

title: Analytics, Tracking & Reporting
heading: Make Marketing Decisions With More Reliable Data
intro: Indieur helps businesses configure and improve the systems used to measure website activity, campaign performance and meaningful customer actions.
challenge: Incomplete or incorrect tracking can make successful campaigns appear ineffective—or make low-quality campaigns appear successful.
Businesses may optimise using clicks, traffic or platform-reported actions without knowing whether those actions created real business value.
approach: We define the actions that matter to the business, review the available technical environment and configure tracking wherever reliable implementation is possible.
Reports distinguish verified business outcomes from supporting or platform-attributed metrics.

faqs.question: Can every action be tracked?
faqs.answer: Not always. Tracking depends on the website, platform permissions, cookie consent, technical implementation and customer journey.

faqs.question: Will reports show exact revenue attribution?
faqs.answer: Revenue reporting depends on the available ecommerce, CRM, offline-sales and attribution data. Limitations will be stated clearly.

faqs.question: Do you support existing GA4 and GTM accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can audit and improve existing implementations or assist with a new setup.

ctaTitle: Build a More Reliable Measurement System

title: Ecommerce Growth Management
heading: Improve the Complete Ecommerce Customer Journey
intro: Indieur helps ecommerce businesses improve how customers discover products, evaluate offers, complete purchases and return for future orders. Support can cover Shopify, WooCommerce and selected marketplace growth requirements.
challenge: Ecommerce performance can be limited by poor product discovery, weak product pages, unclear offers, checkout friction, incomplete tracking or insufficient customer retention.
Increasing advertising alone may not solve these problems.
approach: We assess the journey from customer acquisition to repeat purchase and prioritise the improvements with the strongest relevance to the business.

faqs.question: Do you build ecommerce websites?
faqs.answer: This service focuses on ecommerce growth and management. Major design, development, migration and custom integration requirements are assessed and quoted separately.

faqs.question: Do you manage product uploads?
faqs.answer: Product and catalogue support can be included when the quantity and update frequency are defined in the scope.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee sales?
faqs.answer: No. Ecommerce sales depend on demand, product, pricing, competition, website experience, fulfilment, budget and customer trust.

title: Lead Generation & Conversion Optimisation
breadcrumb: Home / Services / Lead Generation & Conversion Optimisation
heading: Generate Better Enquiries and Improve Conversion
intro: Generate relevant enquiries and improve the journey between campaign clicks, landing pages, follow-ups and qualified leads.
challenge: Generating leads is only one part of the customer acquisition process. Businesses may receive enquiries but struggle to convert them into qualified opportunities or customers.
Lead quality can be affected by the wrong audience, unclear offers, weak landing pages, poorly structured forms, slow follow-up or missing conversion tracking.
Increasing advertising spend without improving the conversion journey can increase lead volume without improving business outcomes.
approach: We review the complete journey from campaign, audience and offer through landing pages, forms, WhatsApp conversations, follow-ups and qualification.
We identify where potential customers are dropping out and prioritise improvements that can strengthen lead quality and conversion.
Tracking and reporting are used to understand which campaigns, sources and conversion points are contributing to meaningful business opportunities.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee a fixed number of leads?
faqs.answer: No. Lead volume and quality depend on market demand, audience, offer, competition, advertising budget, creative quality, landing-page experience and follow-up.

faqs.question: Do you only manage advertising campaigns?
faqs.answer: No. Lead generation and conversion optimisation can cover the wider journey, including campaigns, landing pages, forms, CTAs, tracking, qualification and follow-up recommendations.

faqs.question: Can you improve our existing lead-generation campaigns?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review existing campaigns, landing pages, forms, tracking and lead-handling processes to identify opportunities for improvement.

faqs.question: Do you provide lead follow-up services?
faqs.answer: Follow-up recommendations and journey planning can be included depending on the agreed scope. Actual sales or customer-support activities are separate unless specifically agreed.

ctaTitle: Ready to Improve Your Lead Generation?
